title: Financial statements for CSL (Continental Securities Ltd, BSE 538868) serve Carlisle Companies Inc's (NYSE:CSL) numbers instead
repro: GET http://127.0.0.1:52152/fundamentals/CSL/income (and /balance, /cashflow) with the session region resolving CSL to the BSE small-cap NBFC everywhere else (e.g. GET /fundamentals/CSL correctly returns symbol 'CSL.BO', name 'Continental Securities Limited', market_cap ~76.9cr INR) -> the income/balance/cashflow statement endpoints instead return operating_revenue 2025-12-31 = 5,019,900,000 and net_income_from_continuing_operations 2025-12-31 = 740,700,000, with the statement's own 'symbol' field echoed back as bare 'CSL' (no .BO suffix). The true FY2025-26 figures for Continental Securities Ltd are total income INR 394.40 lakh (~INR 3.94 crore) and PAT INR 219.02 lakh (~INR 2.19 crore) per the company's own board-signed Annual Report and Q1 FY27 filing - a difference of roughly four orders of magnitude, and the account structure (segmented revenue, R&D expense line) matches a large US industrials company, not a Rajasthan NBFC.
evidence: docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/collected/P5_CSL.json calls.income/calls.balance/calls.cashflow vs calls.fundamentals; docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/packs/P5_CSL.json latest_results.figures_inr_lakhs + traps.ticker_collision_three_continents; sidecar/services/yfinance_provider.py:97-135 (_yahoo_symbol ambiguous-ticker fallback) and sidecar/services/symbol_resolver.py:424-444 (region_hint returns None for 'CSL' because it is present in BOTH _bse_master() and _us_master(), by the function's own documented ambiguity rule); sidecar/services/provider_registry.py:495-511 (get_income_statement/get_balance_sheet/get_cash_flow route through _effective_region -> _yahoo_symbol with no company-identity validator, unlike get_fundamentals at provider_registry.py:473-489 which passes accept=_fundamentals_screener_complete and fallback_ok=_fundamentals_has_data).
notes: Root-cause shape: 'CSL' is a genuine symbol collision between an obscure BSE micro-cap and a large NYSE industrial (S&P 500 member). symbol_resolver.region_hint() documents this exact ambiguity and intentionally punts to config.get_region(); the main /fundamentals route additionally protects itself with a completeness/validity gate that the sibling statement endpoints (income/balance/cashflow/ratings) never received, so they fall through yfinance's bare-ticker default and silently serve the wrong company's real, plausible-looking financial statements under the Indian scrip's own ticker. Money-relevant data shown as true for the wrong entity is exactly the critical-severity case COMMON.md defines, and is the single highest-value trap the outside-truth pack predicted in advance (traps.ticker_collision_three_continents). Smallest fix shape: route income/balance/cashflow/ratings through the same resolved Yahoo symbol (or at minimum the same _effective_region + identity cross-check) that /fundamentals already uses, and/or reject a statement whose returned company name/currency doesn't match the resolved instrument.

title: Real, filed zero values for FII/DII holding and promoter pledge render as null/absent instead of 0, and five other sourced ratios are silently blank
repro: GET http://127.0.0.1:52152/disclosures/shareholding?symbol=CSL -> first record (quarter_end 2026-06-30) has fii_percent: null, dii_percent: null, and no pledged/encumbrance field at all, while institutions_percent: 0.0 is correctly served as a real zero alongside it. The SEBI Reg-31 shareholding pattern as on 30-Jun-2026 confirms FII, DII, mutual funds, banks, insurers, AIFs and pension funds are ALL exactly zero (a genuine filed fact, not a gap), and confirms promoter pledge/encumbrance is exactly zero twice in the same filing (Table II line items and the cover declaration). Separately, GET /fundamentals/CSL returns null for price_to_book, book_value, roe, debt_to_equity, revenue_ttm, net_income_ttm and revenue_growth even though screener.in/INDmoney/Groww all publish real values for every one of them (PB 2.84, book value/share 8.52, ROE 10.12%, D/E ~0.007, revenue TTM 4.22cr, net profit TTM 2.4cr, revenue growth YoY ~31-39%).
evidence: docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/collected/P5_CSL.json calls.shareholding.body.patterns[0] and calls.fundamentals.body (price_to_book/book_value/roe/debt_to_equity/revenue_ttm/net_income_ttm/revenue_growth all null); docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/packs/P5_CSL.json shareholding.fii_pct/dii_pct/pledged_pct_of_promoter (all 0.0, each independently sourced) and traps.zero_institutional_holding_is_real, traps.encumbrance_sits_with_the_public_not_the_promoter; docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/diffs/P5_CSL.json fields[] entries for shareholding.fii_pct/dii_pct/pledged_pct_of_promoter/pb/book_value_per_share/roe/debt_to_equity/revenue_ttm/net_profit_ttm/revenue_growth_yoy.
notes: Principle: a blank/null field is indistinguishable from 'data unavailable' to a user or an agent reading it, but for FII/DII/pledge the true value is a confirmed, filed ZERO - a materially different fact from 'unknown', and exactly the failure mode the outside-truth pack calls out by name (a screen or agent that imputes a nonzero institutional holding onto a blank field would invent foreign/domestic institutional ownership in a company that has none; the same inversion risk applies to pledge, described by COMMON.md as the single most gameable Indian small-cap number). The ratio block being null wholesale for a resolvable, actively-traded BSE mainboard name also cuts against the product's 'screener.in-grade density, any listed stock however obscure' promise. Smallest fix shape: (a) shareholding ingestion should distinguish 'field present in filing as 0' from 'field absent from filing' and serve 0 rather than null for the former, adding a pledge/encumbrance field to the schema; (b) the fundamentals ratio fields should fall back to a derived value (net worth/shares outstanding for book value, borrowings/net worth for D/E, etc., as the pack collector itself did) when the primary provider omits them, or at minimum surface a field_meta reason distinguishing 'not published by provider' from silent null, mirroring the pattern field_meta already uses elsewhere in the same response for forward_pe/peg_ratio.
